importResults.title: Import results
importResults.description: Import the SARIF file a scanner produced. The results appear on this branch once the file is processed.

file.label: SARIF file (.sarif, .json or .sarif.gz, 50 MB at most)

errors.missing: Choose a SARIF file to import.
errors.extension: The file must be a .sarif, .json or .sarif.gz file.
errors.size: The file is larger than 50 MB.

typeNote.sca: An SCA import is this branch's whole dependency picture: packages it does not list are marked resolved. Scan the repository root into one file and use one SCA tool per branch.
typeNote.container: A container import is this image's whole picture on this branch: packages it does not list are marked resolved.

image.label: Image
image.hint: The image the file describes, as name[:tag][@sha256:digest].

errors.missing: Enter the image this file describes.
errors.invalid: This is not a valid image reference, for example ghcr.io/acme/api:1.4.2.

errors.missing: Enter the branch these results belong to.
errors.tooLong: The branch name is longer than 255 characters.

errors.invalid: A commit is 7 to 40 hexadecimal characters.

hint.title: Or import from a terminal or a CI job
hint.curl: With curl, a personal access token in CYBEDEFEND_TOKEN
hint.unavailable: The commands appear once the project is loaded.
hint.placeholder: The branch or the image holds characters a terminal could read differently: replace <branch> or <image> yourself before you run the command.

errors.IMPORT_INVALID_REQUEST: The import request is invalid. Check the branch, the commit and the image, then try again.
errors.IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: Only SARIF files can be imported.
errors.IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_FILE: The file must be a .sarif, .json or .sarif.gz file.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_SARIF: The file is not a valid SARIF document.
errors.IMPORT_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 50 MB.
errors.IMPORT_BUSY: Too many imports are in progress. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
errors.IMPORT_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: The file could not be stored. Please try again in a moment.
errors.IMPORT_UNAVAILABLE: The results could not be queued for processing. Please try again in a moment.
errors.IMPORT_IMAGE_REQUIRED: A container import needs the image it describes.
errors.IMPORT_TYPE_NOT_AVAILABLE: This edition does not import this type of results.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large: 50 MB uploaded or 200 MB decompressed at most.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_MANY_RESULTS: The file holds more than 100,000 results.
errors.IMPORT_TOO_MANY_RUNS: The file holds more than 20 runs.
errors.IMPORT_TIMEOUT: The import did not finish in time. Please import the file again.
errors.IMPORT_INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred while importing the results. Please import the file again.
errors.IMPORT_UNSUPPORTED_RESULT: A result of this import lacks its package name or installed version, so nothing was imported. Produce the file with Trivy, Grype or osv-scanner.
errors.IMPORT_INVALID_SBOM: The SBOM is not a CycloneDX JSON document (1.4 to 1.7) this import can read, so nothing was imported. Produce it with trivy fs --format cyclonedx, Syft or cdxgen, and send it with the SARIF of the same scan.
errors.IMPORT_FAILED: The import failed. Please check the file and import it again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to import results into this project.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.GENERIC: The file could not be imported. Please try again.
